criteria.text: Provides a cloud platform for hosting and deploying frontend web applications.
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes platform-focused frontend hosting/deployment products from non-hosting developer tools such as SDKs, libraries, or analytics.

criteria.text: Targets developers as the primary users.
criteria.rationale: Separates developer-facing tooling from end-user or enterprise business applications that merely operate in the same industry.

criteria.text: Prioritizes improving developer experience or developer velocity in its product positioning.
criteria.rationale: Identifies companies that compete on DX and workflow improvements rather than on unrelated features like billing, CRM, or generic cloud infrastructure.

criteria.text: Provides framework-specific tooling or integrations for modern frontend frameworks.
criteria.rationale: Differentiates peers that optimize for frontend frameworks (e.g., Next.js/React) from generic hosting or backend platforms that lack framework-first features.

criteria.text: Operates as a managed platform-as-a-service that abstracts infrastructure for web developers.
criteria.rationale: Filters for SaaS platforms that remove infrastructure complexity for dev teams rather than self-managed tools or purely on-premise software.
